# Oxygen Copilot Instructions

This file exists only for Copilot compatibility.

- `AGENTS.md` and `CLAUDE.md` are the two authoritative repo instruction files, and they must stay synchronized.
- If they change, update both in the same edit.
- If repo instructions conflict with the latest user request in the current chat, the user request wins.
- Oxygen hot memory is maintained at `/home/user3/.claude/projects/-mnt-w2-scratch-user3-Oxygen/memory/`; use that as the live project memory source.
- For repo-specific review and commit drafting workflows, consult the mirrored skill docs under `.claude/skills/` and `.agents/skills/`.
